text: Shane and Som watch a horror movie in which villagers hang Chaba, a woman who kidnapped and murdered children, and learn it is drawn from a real case thirty years old. Digging further, Shane finds a behind-the-scenes clip. Ingchan, the actress playing Chaba, was made to [reshoot the hanging until it looked real|wrong|exploitation for profit], and on the last take [her safety sling snapped|images|ropes, cages and executions]. That take is in the released film, and now [those who watch it|trigger|seeing or hearing too much] are [drawn into the scene on the screen|rules|reality comes apart].
